purpose: Add auditable fixed facet anchors to the native exact CMLE likelihood as affine constraints, while preserving the unanchored estimator and propagating the fixed offsets through every downstream CMLE-WLE calculation.

supported: RSM and PCM hard anchors on observed non-Person facet levels
one or more partially or fully anchored facet blocks
fixed anchor values on the expanded structural-estimate scale before facet-sign application
conditional likelihood, category surfaces, fit-sample WLE, Person fit, bootstrap, and calibration-uncertainty paths
withheld: public one-click UI exposure until operating-characteristic evidence passes

public_api_contract.accepted_container: pandas DataFrame or sequence of mappings; None means legacy unanchored CMLE
public_api_contract.step_rule: must be absent or entirely missing for facet anchors
public_api_contract.value_rule: finite numeric, interpreted on the expanded structural-estimate scale
public_api_contract.identity_rule: Facet and Level must match retained design labels exactly after their existing string normalization
public_api_contract.duplicate_rule: duplicate Facet-Level keys are rejected even when values agree
public_api_contract.ordering_rule: canonicalized by design facet and level order so input anchor-row order cannot affect results

estimation_contract.unanchored_facet: retain the existing sum-to-zero contrast and parameter names
estimation_contract.anchored_facet: anchored levels have fixed offsets and zero Jacobian rows; each unanchored level receives one direct free coordinate; no additional sum-to-zero constraint is imposed on that facet
estimation_contract.conditional_likelihood: both observed log kernel and conditional normalizer include fixed offsets
estimation_contract.rank_audit: performed on the remaining free-coordinate information with fixed offsets present in conditional probabilities
estimation_contract.anchored_output: Estimate equals the supplied anchor exactly, SE equals 0, Anchored is true, Constraint is hard_anchor
estimation_contract.unanchored_output: Anchored is false and Constraint states sum_to_zero or free_relative_to_hard_anchor
estimation_contract.likelihood_parameter_count: KParams and conditional AIC count only optimized free coordinates; fixed anchors are not counted

legacy_identity.requirement: hard_anchors=None reproduces prechange free names, objective, gradient, Hessian, fitted estimates, surfaces, WLE, and Person fit
legacy_identity.note: exact equality is preferred, but the prospective gate is numerical because benign array-expression changes may alter final floating-point bits

manual_affine_enumeration.requirement: a small anchored RSM objective and gradient agree with explicit enumeration of response patterns

finite_difference_gradient.requirement: anchored analytical gradient agrees with central finite differences

propagation.requirement: surfaces, WLE, Person fit, bootstrap kernels, and uncertainty draws use the same fixed row offsets

invariance.requirement: permuting anchor rows cannot change canonical anchors or numerical results

phase_b_smoke_design.status: run only after implementation gates pass
phase_b_smoke_design.source_bytes: reuse deterministic known-truth generator settings, but save new retained response files and hashes
primary_outputs: unanchored rater bias, MAE, and RMSE on the explicitly labelled scale
WLE bias, MAE, RMSE, and exact-extreme counts
raw-value Person-fit flag transitions relative to the same-byte unanchored fit
phase_b_smoke_design.interpretation: engineering smoke and direction-of-effect evidence only; two replicates do not support performance, robustness, or cross-engine claims

decision_policy.ui_release: withheld until a larger prospectively registered anchor-proportion, contamination, sparse-connectivity, bias, and cross-engine study
